% An article whose headings have their own fonts in \@startsection: a
% section in \large sans-serif italic, not bold, and a run-in paragraph in
% italic. The subsection keeps article's font.
\documentclass{article}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\section{\@startsection{section}{1}{\z@}{-3.5ex \@plus -1ex \@minus -.2ex}%
    {2.3ex \@plus.2ex}{\normalfont\large\sffamily\itshape}}
\renewcommand\paragraph{\@startsection{paragraph}{4}{\z@}{3.25ex \@plus1ex \@minus.2ex}%
    {-1em}{\normalfont\normalsize\itshape}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\section{A section}
Some text.
\subsection{A subsection}
More text.
\paragraph{A paragraph} Text after it.
\end{document}
